calculation_handling.description: Scope statement: Section 10.20 governs all lands, uses, buildings and structures in the RD zone. It sets no numeric value.

10.20.1.10(1).explanation: This states that the Residential Detached (RD) zone rules in Section 10.20 apply to every lot, use and building in the RD zone. It is a scope statement and sets no limit by itself.
